title: Cold direct entry claims the installed version is current and offers no check
reproduction: On a direct-update eligible installation open the app-update notification after process death; no Home startup check or daily worker supplies a result. Alternatively open the version link with automatic checks off.
expected: No version verdict without a fresh manifest; offer a real check on eligible builds and allow retry after failure.
observed: Confirmed by source: uninitialized manifest LiveData does not deliver null. The XML up-to-date header and Last changes survive; IDLE hides the only button wired to refresh. An actual null from a passive check also hides the button.
fix: Neutral layout; distinguish not checked from failed; expose the model's eligibility for a manual manifest check; only a real phase shows progress. Preserve fresh result and installer actions.
test_evidence: Offline focused Java compilation and XML checks passed. Android test coldNotificationEntryCanCheckAndRetryUntilCurrent authored with loopback failure then signed current response; not run.
